subsystems.name: Data pipeline
subsystems.role: collects and filters the text and code used for training.

subsystems.name: Model architecture
subsystems.role: the neural network that learns patterns and generates text.

subsystems.name: Training infrastructure
subsystems.role: trains the model on a large distributed cluster.

subsystems.name: Alignment and fine-tuning
subsystems.role: makes the model helpful, truthful and safe.

subsystems.name: Real-time integration
subsystems.role: connects the model to live data streams from X.

subsystems.name: Inference serving
subsystems.role: runs the model for users at low latency.

buildSteps.title: Collect training data
buildSteps.detail: Gather a large corpus of text from the web, books, code, and public X posts.

buildSteps.title: Clean and filter
buildSteps.detail: Remove duplicates, spam, personal data and harmful content; balance the mix of sources.

buildSteps.title: Train a tokenizer
buildSteps.detail: Learn a subword vocabulary that splits text into tokens the model can process.

buildSteps.title: Pre-train the model
buildSteps.detail: Train a transformer on the corpus using a large cluster of GPUs for an extended period, predicting the next token.

buildSteps.title: Fine-tune on curated examples
buildSteps.detail: Continue training on high-quality question-answer pairs and instructions to shape behaviour.

buildSteps.title: Align with human feedback
buildSteps.detail: Use reinforcement learning from human feedback to reward truthful, helpful answers and penalise errors.

buildSteps.title: Integrate real-time data
buildSteps.detail: Build a retrieval pipeline that pulls relevant, recent X posts and other live information into the model's context.

buildSteps.title: Deploy for inference
buildSteps.detail: Optimize the model for serving, set up API endpoints and a chat interface on X, and add caching for speed.

buildSteps.title: Monitor and update
buildSteps.detail: Continuously evaluate outputs, fix safety issues, and retrain or fine-tune as new data and feedback arrive.
